summary: Full E2E + regression for Substack-style Writing Desk redesign. All 22 review-request features pass: slim stats row, count-chip tabs, new-essay toggle, mode switch (post/essay), wrapping title textarea (scrollHeight grew to 198px on long input, no overflow), italic subtitle input, short-post body with 500-char cap, floating selection toolbar (renders 44px above editor, visible only when selection non-empty, hides on blur), markdown wraps (Bold ** correctly applied), publish-drawer button gated by content + opens drawer with overlay, drawer schedule/audience/regions/prompt/attachments sections all render, Escape and overlay click both close drawer, auto-save fires after 5s producing [data-testid=draft-saved], embed URL row attaches YouTube link, GET /api/release-window /prompts/current /me/writer/stats|published|scheduled all 200. Old testid composer-text fully retired - no stale references in src.

issues: Console warning from tiptap: 'Duplicate extension names found: [link]'. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up by removing the duplicate Link extension registration in RichTextEditor.

action_items: (LOW) De-dup the tiptap 'link' extension registration in RichTextEditor to silence the duplicate-name console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: FloatingToolbar anchors to the textarea's top center rather than the actual selection bounding rect (textareas cannot expose per-char client rects without a mirror div). For short textareas this is acceptable, but for the long essay markdown mode the pill can sit far from the selected text. If pixel-accurate anchoring becomes a UX requirement, mirror the textarea into a hidden div with identical styles and read the selected range's rect from there.

Composer.jsx is large (~540 lines) - upload handlers, polling, draft save, and submit could be extracted into hooks (useDraftAutoSave, useMediaUploads) to keep the view layer focused. Not blocking the redesign.

PublishDrawer click-overlay close works, but the drawer aside element still receives pointer events when closed because translate-x-full doesn't disable focus. Add aria-hidden / tabIndex=-1 on the aside when !open to prevent tab-trap into hidden buttons.
Auto-save useEffect dependency array includes `images` (derived array recreated each render) which can cause extra timer resets. Memoize images via useMemo or depend on media only.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded smoke admin session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Writing Desk redesign verified end-to-end. The body textarea testid is now 'editor-body-textarea' (old 'composer-text' removed everywhere). To exercise the FloatingToolbar in essay mode you MUST first click [data-testid=essay-editor-markdown] so the textarea is mounted (visual mode uses tiptap which has its own toolbar). When selecting programmatically dispatch a 'select' and 'keyup' event on the textarea so the toolbar's listeners fire. Drawer open state is reflected by the 'translate-x-0' class on [data-testid=publish-settings-drawer] (the element is always in the DOM).
